name: Keyideas Ring Filter & Search
author: Keyideas Infotech Private Limited

sections.description:
Easily find engagement rings and wedding bands instantly using our advanced search plugin. Our quick and intelligent search bar, along with easy-to-use search results and advanced filters, ensures a seamless experience. No coding skills are needed—our product search widgets adapt automatically to your theme. Benefit from responsive support and regular product updates for a smooth journey.

Smart Filter which finds matches across all in-store products
Custom Product Filter: Metal Type, Collections, Diamond Shapes, Price, and more.
Advanced Sorting options to boost sales
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements:
– PHP 7.0 or higher
– MySQL 5.6 or higher
– WordPress 5.5 or higher

Recommended Requirements:
– PHP 8.1 or higher
– MySQL 5.7 or higher
– WordPress 6.7 or higher

  1. Upload the plugin folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress Plugin Store.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings under the “Ring Filter & Search” menu in your dashboard.
